description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing and evaluating system requirements such as binaries, environment variables, OS, and configuration paths. It includes functions to resolve missing requirements and assess eligibility based on local and remote system states.

methods.name: resolveMissingBins
methods.description: Filters required binaries to identify which are missing locally and remotely.

methods.name: resolveMissingAnyBins
methods.description: Checks if any of the required binaries are present locally or remotely.

methods.name: resolveMissingOs
methods.description: Determines which OS requirements are missing based on local and remote platforms.

methods.name: resolveMissingEnv
methods.description: Identifies environment variables that are not satisfied.

methods.name: buildConfigChecks
methods.description: Creates configuration check objects indicating satisfaction status.

methods.name: evaluateRequirements
methods.description: Evaluates overall system requirements, returning missing items and eligibility.

methods.name: evaluateRequirementsFromMetadata
methods.description: Evaluates requirements based on provided metadata and system context.

methods.name: evaluateRequirementsFromMetadataWithRemote
methods.description: Evaluates requirements with remote system context and optional remote requirement checks.
